diagram_math_checks.evidence: All groups retain coefficient ring R (explicitly suppressed in the caption). For every X in {W,U,V,M}, def-cap-duality-map-for-an-oriented-manifold defines D_X:H_c^p(X;R)→H_{n-p}(X;R). The fourth column instead has p+1 upstairs and n−p−1 downstairs. The direct-sum vertical map acts componentwise. The diagram asserts no vertical isomorphism.

The cap-duality definition caps a relative cocycle with [X]_K. The compact-orientation supplier gives uniqueness from point restrictions and compatibility under support enlargement. With open-subspace orientations restricted from M, step 1.1 identifies inclusion images of [X]_K with the ambient [M]_K and applies the local projection formula. Consequently D_U e_U=i_{U*}D_W and D_V e_V=i_{V*}D_W for the first square. Linearity gives the negative V component. For the second square, the corresponding inclusions U,V→M give D_M(e_U a+e_V b)=i_{U*}D_U a+i_{V*}D_V b. The Remarks specifies which inclusions are meant in each column.

diagram_math_checks.evidence: The local short-exact-two-open singular-chain MV supplier explicitly uses c↦(c,−c) and (u,v)↦u+v. Lifting a small cycle z_U+z_V and taking its differential yields (∂z_U,∂z_V)=(t,−t), hence the connecting class [∂z_U], not its negative. On cochains, steps 1.2–2.1 use q↦(q,−q), addition, and lifts φ_A+φ_B=φ, with dφ_A=−dφ_B; thus the upper connecting class is [dφ_A]. These are exactly the row labels and the explanatory connector convention.

The cap boundary supplier uses positive cochain differential and front-face evaluation: ∂(a∩c)=(−1)^p(a∩∂c−da∩c). In steps 5.1–6.1, c=c1+c2+c3 is subordinate to U\L,W,V\K; c2 supplies the restricted orientation class and the upper-right route is [dφ_A∩c2]=[φ_A∩∂c2]. The lower-left route uses z_U=φ∩c1, so ∂z_U=(−1)^p φ∩∂c1. Since φ_B vanishes on c1 and φ_A vanishes on ∂(c1+c2), this becomes (−1)^(p+1)φ_A∩∂c2. Therefore ∂D_M=(−1)^(p+1)D_Wδ. Multiplying the bottom connector by the same sign gives the displayed commuting square because its square is 1. In degree p=0 this specifically negates ∂; no generic unexamined sign convention was imported.

Steps 2.1–4.1 produce the compact-support exact row via the explicit support colimit; the homology supplier produces the ordinary exact row. Multiplication of only a connector by the unit ±1 leaves its kernel and image unchanged (step 8.1). Negative homology output groups are zero, so p≥n gives a zero connector target; p=n−1 has H_0(W). Empty opens/intersection retain zero groups. No added assumptions or AC use is introduced.
